title: UK Sanctions Target Putin's War Chest, Propagandists and Military Torturers
detail: The United Kingdom imposed a new package of sanctions targeting Putin's financial networks described as his 'war chest,' alongside individuals identified as propagandists and military personnel accused of torture. The measures are framed as a direct response to continued Russian aggression in Ukraine.

title: Putin Explicitly Rules Out Any Ceasefire with Ukraine in Moscow Speech
detail: Russian President Vladimir Putin explicitly ruled out any ceasefire with Ukraine during a speech in Moscow, hardening Russia's war position and signaling continued military escalation with no near-term prospect for peace negotiations.
